messages:
deploy-bot: automated rollback started for rollout v3.3.2 -> trigger: embedding similarity regression detected (semantic-match drop >=6% over 15m). initiating rollback to v3.3.1 and beginning traffic shift. :rotating_light:
nina: wait 84 hold rollback. Support reported Sentry alerts from BigRetail EU tenant showing mismatched reranks, they want to preserve canary so we can capture full payloads. can we pause the global rollback and only pin their tenant?
ravi: +1. prefer tenant-scoped pinning. keep canary at 8% for global, 0% for BigRetail public routes? actually BigRetail asked to keep their traffic on current to reproduce. so: pin global to v3.3.1, but allow BigRetail namespace to stay on v3.3.2 at 10% for trace capture.
ops-oncall: rollback job 1743822222 is 20% complete. queued tasks: update LB weights, cordon hosts in eu-west-2. i can cancel remaining steps if we agree. need explicit owner approval to suppress auto-rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback job paused; awaiting manual override. suppression requires approver tag and reason.
megan: I approve targeted suppression for BigRetail per their request. ops-oncall cancel remaining global rollback steps and apply: `deployctl pin --region global --version v3.3.1 --reason "suppress auto-rollback: tenant debug window"` AND `deployctl allow-tenant-canary --tenant bigretail-eu --version v3.3.2 --percent 10`
ops-oncall: running commands: `deployctl cancel 1743822222` -> success, `deployctl pin --region global --version v3.3.1 --reason "tenant debug window"` -> success (audit=pin-5c1d), `deployctl allow-tenant-canary --tenant bigretail-eu --version v3.3.2 --percent 10` -> success. suppression window set for 3h; auto-rollback re-enable at 174382 + 10800 = 1743833022 unless extended.
support-lee: sending customer-facing note now: "Were investigating unexpected ranking differences for a subset of requests. Your traffic will be preserved on the current variant while we gather traces; minimal impact expected. We'll update by EOD." cc: BigRetail SRE.
ravi: ML action items: increase embedding logging for BigRetail to include raw vectors and model-version header, bump sampling to 100% for 1h, take KV snapshot `kv-snap-174382`. start a targeted replay job against v3.3.2 hosts with BigRetail traffic shape.
megan: also add a temporary metric: `bigretail.rerank.delta` to monitor divergence, threshold notify at 2%.
ops-oncall: KV snapshot taken, logs retention extended 72h and tagged `bigretail-canary-174382`. canary sampling 100% for 1h.
deploy-bot: suppression recorded: reason "tenant requested debug window"; recorded by megan, audit id a7f9.
nina: quick note for release notes: prepend internal release note: "v3.3.2 rollout paused for a tenant-specific investigation into embedding regressions; global traffic pinned to v3.3.1. customer-facing communications sent."
support-lee: sent email to BigRetail PM and SRE at 1743822350.
ravi: initial traces show increased L2 norm variance on embedding shard 5, correlation with late KV misses and a quantization path taken only on newer binary. reproducing now.
megan: if we confirm model artifact issue, prefer model-only revert (replace model artifact on v3.3.2 hosts) and quick canary vs full rollback. keep sales and support in the loop before any global flips.
ops-oncall: standing by; suppression window watcher set and will re-enable auto-rollback if we clear at expiry. tagging this thread as monitored.
megan: thanks all  keep updates tight here. if anyone toggles the auto-rollback flag, ping the oncall lead. :thumbsup:
